description: Tests whether gtransformer can learn using ONLY interpretability constraints (lambda_sup=0) without direct supervision on predictions. Baseline: Exp 636452 (Active Grounding).
research_question: Can a model trained purely on pedagogical constraints (BKT reference loss + parameter grounding + probing) achieve reasonable predictive performance without any direct supervision on prediction accuracy?

expected_outcomes.scenario_1: AUC > 0.75 - Strong evidence that interpretability constraints encode rich information
expected_outcomes.scenario_2: 0.65 < AUC < 0.75 - Moderate performance, measurable cost to pure interpretability
expected_outcomes.scenario_3: AUC < 0.65 - Direct supervision is essential for performance
